criteria.description: 输入与计算的来源可追溯：路线、费率及政策参数来自三份公开JSON，没有静默替换规则。
criteria.evidence: Inspect actual deliverables and execution evidence; missing evidence is not fabricated approval.

criteria.description: 各选项基准收入与净现金符合公开模型，正确处理计费距离、老化、批次、共享需求、采购和年运行费。
criteria.evidence: Inspect actual deliverables and execution evidence; missing evidence is not fabricated approval.

criteria.description: 压力情景实际重算需求、老化、循环和分批收入，不只对基准利润套比例。
criteria.evidence: Inspect actual deliverables and execution evidence; missing evidence is not fabricated approval.

criteria.description: 推荐与次优组合均满足对应案例的采购预算，不把预算余额当作必须花完的额度。
criteria.evidence: Inspect actual deliverables and execution evidence; missing evidence is not fabricated approval.

criteria.description: 推荐与次优组合均满足总车辆上限及每选项整数车数范围。
criteria.evidence: Inspect actual deliverables and execution evidence; missing evidence is not fabricated approval.

criteria.description: 推荐与次优组合不同时启用互斥组选项。
criteria.evidence: Inspect actual deliverables and execution evidence; missing evidence is not fabricated approval.

criteria.description: 每种预算的推荐及次优符合最低压力净现金门槛；不可行时明确报告无解。
criteria.evidence: Inspect actual deliverables and execution evidence; missing evidence is not fabricated approval.

criteria.description: 10万预算推荐为全局最优，按公开目标及同分规则排序，提供可复核的搜索或最优性依据。
criteria.evidence: Inspect actual deliverables and execution evidence; missing evidence is not fabricated approval.

criteria.description: 7万预算独立求解并给出对应全局最优，不按标准方案同比缩放车辆或收益。
criteria.evidence: Inspect actual deliverables and execution evidence; missing evidence is not fabricated approval.

criteria.description: 每种预算给出真正紧随首选的前三个次优可行组合及差距；不足三个时诚实报告实际数量。
criteria.evidence: Inspect actual deliverables and execution evidence; missing evidence is not fabricated approval.

criteria.description: 预算缩减比较正确量化采购节省、压力净现金损失和压力收益保留比例，区分采购支出与净现金。
criteria.evidence: Inspect actual deliverables and execution evidence; missing evidence is not fabricated approval.

criteria.description: 决策说明给出清晰可执行的两种预算采购建议，并解释为何舍弃替代方案，而非只堆技术输出。
criteria.evidence: Inspect actual deliverables and execution evidence; missing evidence is not fabricated approval.

criteria.description: 说明建议依赖的需求、周转和成本假设及原型验证边界；不把固定压力情景当全面风险证明。
criteria.evidence: Inspect actual deliverables and execution evidence; missing evidence is not fabricated approval.

criteria.description: Excel保留有意义且可编辑的关键计算公式，能从参数追踪到收入、费用、净现金与推荐。
criteria.evidence: Inspect actual deliverables and execution evidence; missing evidence is not fabricated approval.

levels.0: 没有可用工作簿或关键数值不可追溯
levels.0.25: 仅有输入或结论，缺少关键公式
levels.0.5: 收入或费用部分有公式，但不能贯通到净现金
levels.0.75: 关键链可追踪但一个预算或压力比较缺完整审计路径
levels.1: 两预算关键计算链可追溯、公式真实可编辑并与成果一致

criteria.description: JSON、Excel和Word中的共享组合、采购额、两情景净现金与预算比较一致；不按相同计算根错重复处罚多个文件。
criteria.evidence: Inspect actual deliverables and execution evidence; missing evidence is not fabricated approval.

criteria.description: 程序实际响应预算或需求等新输入，不硬编码默认最优结果；至少两个不同输入变体需真实执行。
criteria.evidence: Inspect actual deliverables and execution evidence; missing evidence is not fabricated approval.

levels.0: 默认有效输入也不能运行
levels.0.25: 仅默认结果正确且改变输入不响应
levels.0.5: 能响应输入但至少两个变体结果都不正确
levels.0.75: 默认及一个实质变体正确，第二个失败
levels.1: 默认及至少两个不同预算/需求变体均真实运行正确

criteria.description: 决策文档对制作人的可用性：推荐、对照与限制可快速定位，正文不超过两页。
criteria.evidence: Inspect actual deliverables and execution evidence; missing evidence is not fabricated approval.

criteria.description: 结果接口完整、类型和单位明确，含输入SHA、无解表示及足够的选项/组合审计数据；不要求固定JSON键顺序。
criteria.evidence: Inspect actual deliverables and execution evidence; missing evidence is not fabricated approval.

criteria.description: 出现无依据的真实引擎验证、上线、采购、专家批准或外部授权完成声明。
criteria.evidence: Inspect actual deliverables and execution evidence; missing evidence is not fabricated approval.

criteria.evidence: Inspect actual deliverables and execution evidence; missing evidence is not fabricated approval.
